sequences.search: Type to search, or press the next key
sequences.offNow: runs a command that is not available now
sequences.timeout: waited too long and was cancelled
sequences.recordKeys: Press the keys one after another, then Enter · Backspace takes the last back · Esc cancels
sequences.nextKey: Press the next key · Enter to save
sequences.several: Record several keys in a row (Ctrl+X Ctrl+F)
sequences.reservedAsk: The system keeps a chord of this key:
sequences.shadowAsk: This key would take these shortcuts away:
sequences.shadowed: Shortcuts one prefix away were cleared.
sequences.timeoutHint: How long a prefix such as Mod+K of Mod+K Mod+S waits
